answers.reason: The president leads the university and chairs its central bodies, of which the senate is the primary one deciding overall strategy and structure.
The chancellor is specifically responsible for the budget, and each member takes part in only one body.
The president only participates in their designated central body and does not sit in committees dealing with other specific questions like faculty appointments.
The faculty council is chaired by the dean and handles faculty affairs, while the president does not sit in bodies outside their specific domain.
The study commission deals with degree programmes, which is outside the president's single designated place of participation.
The examination board handles individual student examination matters, and the president does not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
This round awards faculty internal grants, which is a faculty-level research matter outside the president's single central body.
Rewriting module descriptions is a specific teaching task, and higher officers do not sit in bodies that deal with other kinds of questions.
Choosing laboratory equipment is a specific operational task outside the central strategy body where the president takes part.
Planning the orientation week for new students is outside the single central body where the president participates.
